aggregation: First aggregate 600 episodes per checkpoint and condition, then compute the mean and sample standard deviation across five independent training seeds (ddof=1).

protocol.episode_allocation: 100 environments; the first two counted episodes from each environment per evaluation seed
protocol.command_interpretation: Random velocity and heading commands resampled every 8 seconds; heading feedback determines the executed yaw-rate command.
protocol.ground_friction_provenance: Ground values are configured parameters; robot-shape friction is also recorded through simulator readback.

comparison_with_video.difference: The qualitative video uses a prescribed 24-second velocity/yaw schedule, first-episode screening and timeout-without-physical-failure completion. This robustness table uses randomized velocity/heading commands and balanced two-episode environment quotas. Differences between results are not attributed to commands alone.
comparison_with_video.low_friction: Both protocols set ground static/dynamic friction and robot-shape friction to 0.20; their outcome rates remain separate.
